datasets.name: Kenneth French Data Library
datasets.description: Fama-French 3- and 5-factor returns, industry portfolios, and benchmark data since 1926. The foundational dataset for empirical asset pricing.

datasets.name: AQR Data Library
datasets.description: Factor returns from published AQR papers: Betting Against Beta, Quality Minus Junk, Value and Momentum Everywhere across 8 asset classes. Downloadable without payment, but AQR's Terms of Use forbid all redistribution. Download for personal research analysis only; sharing in thesis appendices, replication packages, or repositories requires AQR's written consent.

datasets.name: Global Factor Library (JKP)
datasets.description: 153 characteristics/factors clustered into 13 themes across 93 countries. Includes long/short factor portfolios (free download) and stock-level characteristics (requires WRDS subscription). Jensen, Kelly, and Pedersen (Journal of Finance, 2023).
datasets.availability: US from 1926; international varies by country
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (factor returns); WRDS subscription required for stock-level data

datasets.name: Open Source Asset Pricing (Chen & Zimmermann)
datasets.description: 212 cross-sectional stock return predictors with both stock-level signals and portfolio implementations. 98% of clearly significant characteristics replicate. Chen and Zimmermann (Critical Finance Review, 2022).

datasets.name: Currency Factors
datasets.description: Currency investment strategy returns including carry, value, momentum, and other factors. Currencies ranked monthly, formed into five portfolios. Della Corte and Riddiough (Annual Review of Financial Economics, 2025).

datasets.name: Yahoo Finance
datasets.description: Historical OHLCV for equities, ETFs, indices, and FX. De facto standard in open-source ML-finance code. Note: yfinance is an unofficial scraper and not an authorised API; Yahoo's Terms of Service prohibit commercial use of the data.

datasets.name: Binance Historical Data
datasets.description: Official OHLCV from 1-second to monthly for all spot and futures pairs since 2017. No account required. CSV/ZIP download.

datasets.name: Dukascopy Historical Data
datasets.description: Tick-level bid/ask data for 60+ FX pairs, gold, oil, and major indices (15+ years). From a Swiss-regulated bank. Free account required.

datasets.name: Kaggle Financial Datasets
datasets.description: Various financial datasets including stock prices, options, cryptocurrency, and alternative data. Community-contributed with competitions. Note: licenses vary per dataset (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC-SA, and others); check the individual dataset page before any commercial use.

datasets.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
datasets.description: 800,000+ time series from the St. Louis Fed. Includes the curated FRED-MD (monthly) and FRED-QD (quarterly) panels by McCracken & Ng, designed for ML factor analysis.

datasets.name: Welch & Goyal Macro Predictors
datasets.description: 15+ macro/valuation variables for equity premium prediction, updated annually. The standard benchmark dataset for return prediction research. Welch and Goyal (Review of Financial Studies, 2008).

datasets.name: Global Macro Database
datasets.description: Harmonized international macroeconomic dataset integrating 111 data sources. Covers 77 variables across 240 countries. Mueller, Xu, Lehbib, and Chen (NBER Working Paper No. 33714, 2025).

datasets.name: BIS Data Portal
datasets.description: Cross-border banking statistics, credit-to-GDP gaps, debt service ratios, and FX triennial survey from the Bank for International Settlements. Essential for systemic risk research.

datasets.name: World Bank Open Data
datasets.description: 16,000+ development indicators across 200+ countries. Includes GDP, trade, poverty, governance, and climate-related metrics. REST API and bulk CSV downloads.

datasets.name: IMF Data (IFS, WEO)
datasets.description: International Financial Statistics (IFS), World Economic Outlook (WEO), and Balance of Payments data across 190 countries. Exchange rates, interest rates, national accounts, and external sector data.

datasets.name: ECB Data Portal
datasets.description: Euro area interest rates, banking statistics, securities holdings (SHS), bank lending surveys, and exchange rates. REST API available.

datasets.name: Eurostat
datasets.description: EU economic statistics: HICP inflation, labor markets, national accounts, and financial indicators for all member states.

datasets.name: Deutsche Bundesbank Data
datasets.description: German financial markets, capital markets, and banking statistics with time series back to the 1950s. Directly relevant for research with Frankfurt-based partners.

datasets.name: EU ETS Emissions Data
datasets.description: Firm-level verified greenhouse gas emissions for all EU ETS installations since 2005 (EEA open data). Covers ~40% of EU total emissions. Standard for European carbon finance research.

datasets.name: CBOE VIX Historical Data
datasets.description: VIX daily closing values from 1990, VIX futures daily OHLCV with open interest by contract month. Also available on FRED (VIXCLS). Note: CBOE's Terms of Use restrict the freely posted historical data to personal non-commercial use; commercial redistribution or product integration requires written consent from CBOE.

datasets.name: Fed Board Yield Curve Models
datasets.description: Daily nominal and real (TIPS) zero-coupon yield curves, Kim-Wright term premium decomposition. The authoritative yield curve dataset.

datasets.name: LOBSTER
datasets.description: Reconstructed NASDAQ limit order book data at any depth level since 2009. Free sample files available; academic subscription for full data. Huang & Polak (2011).
datasets.license: Free samples; academic subscription for full data

datasets.name: SEC EDGAR
datasets.description: 20M+ electronic filings since 1993. XBRL Financial Statement Data Sets provide structured fundamentals. Full text enables NLP research; see Loughran & McDonald (Journal of Finance, 2011).

datasets.name: SimFin
datasets.description: Clean income statements, balance sheets, and cash flows for 5,000 US stocks via Python API. Free tier includes 5 years of fundamentals history; paid tiers extend coverage and add features.

datasets.name: SEC Insider & Institutional Holdings
datasets.description: Bulk structured data: Form 4 insider transactions and Form 13F quarterly institutional holdings. Academic version: Layline dataset (Nature Scientific Data, 2023; Harvard Dataverse).

datasets.name: N-PORT (SEC Filings)
datasets.description: Free public source for US mutual fund and ETF holdings data. N-PORT filings contain detailed portfolio holdings from registered investment companies at the fund-by-quarter level.

datasets.name: GLEIF Global LEI Index
datasets.description: 2.5M+ legal entities with ownership relationships (who owns whom). REST API available. Useful for building corporate ownership graphs for GNN-based contagion or risk propagation research.

datasets.name: GDELT Project
datasets.description: Real-time global news event graph covering 100+ languages since 1979, updated every 15 minutes. Structured event records with tone scores. Available on Google BigQuery (compute costs may apply) and as direct CSV downloads.

datasets.name: Google Trends
datasets.description: Weekly search volume indices for any keyword since 2004. Preis, Moat & Stanley (Scientific Reports, 2013) showed predictive power for DJIA movements. Note: pytrends is an unofficial package; Google's Terms of Service restrict commercial use of the data.

datasets.name: Hugging Face Finance Datasets
datasets.description: Community hub for ML datasets and pretrained models. Hosts finance-specific datasets (earnings calls, SEC filings, financial news) and models (FinBERT, FinGPT). Licenses vary per dataset.

datasets.name: Financial PhraseBank
datasets.description: 4,840 expert-annotated financial sentences for sentiment classification. Malo et al. (2014). The baseline dataset behind FinBERT.

datasets.name: Loughran-McDonald Master Dictionary
datasets.description: Financial sentiment word lists with 86,000+ words classified into Negative, Positive, Uncertainty, Litigious, and other categories. The standard lexicon for financial text analysis. Loughran and McDonald (Journal of Finance, 2011). Updated through 2024.
datasets.license: Free for academic use; commercial use requires contacting the authors

datasets.name: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database
datasets.description: 5M+ consumer complaints against financial companies with product type, issue, narrative text, and company response. Public data from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. Useful for NLP, text classification, and consumer finance research.

datasets.name: Numerai Tournament Data
datasets.description: Anonymized, cleaned financial features and targets for stock market prediction. Free download with registration. Data is bound to tournament participation; redistribution is forbidden by Numerai's Terms of Service. Used as a standardized ML benchmark in finance. Updated weekly.
datasets.license: Free for tournament use; see Numerai Terms of Service for restrictions
